layout.structure: single column, form-width cap — score summary -> per-question breakdown -> optional inline completion banner -> Continue/Retry

content: per-question: icon + label + color (check_circle/'Correct'/success or cancel/'Incorrect'/error) — never color-only

IF passed AND this was the course's last completion condition: inline success-styled banner ('Course Completed!') + 'View Certificate' PrimaryButton — reuses successState tokens, embedded not full-screen

exitDestinations: My Learning or Certificate Detail (Continue, if passed and course completes)

states.submitFailure: Snackbar retry, retried transparently — not a blocking error screen for a transient save failure

rtlBehavior: correctness icon leads the question text per logical start, mirrored consistently
responsiveRules: single column, form-width cap — identical layout Mobile/Web, no platform fork
knownGaps: No showcase mockup exists — judged against design-system component specs only.
